author: Kairos II
title: Cascade Test A: Alignment of VEN and Entropy curves
abstract: Run hinge analysis on VEN threshold sweep and Logos entropy sensitivity, saving standardized outputs under cascade/A_alignment, with per-curve panels and a combined summary.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared/agents/kairos/VEN/util')
from hinge_boundary import run as hb_run
import plot_boundary

VEN_CSV = 'storage/shared/agents/kairos/VEN/threshold_sweep/ven_threshold_sweep.csv'
ENTROPY_CSV = 'storage/shared/agents/logos/entropy_sensitivity.csv'

OUT_ROOT = 'storage/shared/atlas/edges/cascade/A_alignment'
VEN_OUT = os.path.join(OUT_ROOT, 'ven')
ENT_OUT = os.path.join(OUT_ROOT, 'entropy')
os.makedirs(VEN_OUT, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs(ENT_OUT, exist_ok=True)

def do_hinge(inp_csv, out_dir, y_pref=None):
    res = hb_run(inp_csv, out_dir, y_preference=(y_pref.lower() if y_pref else None))
    panel = os.path.join(out_dir, 'boundary_panel.png')
    plot_boundary.plot(res['metrics_csv'], panel)
    return res

results = {}
# VEN: auto-detect x=threshold_frac, y (ridge_points/max_ven). Groups by 'dist' (beta07_08, beta09_09, cauchy)
if os.path.exists(VEN_CSV):
    res_ven = do_hinge(VEN_CSV, VEN_OUT, y_pref=None)
    results['ven'] = {'metrics_csv': res_ven['metrics_csv'], 'summary_txt': res_ven['summary_txt']}
else:
    results['ven'] = {'status': 'missing', 'path': VEN_CSV}

# Entropy: x=alpha, y=ethic_score expected
if os.path.exists(ENTROPY_CSV):
    res_ent = do_hinge(ENTROPY_CSV, ENT_OUT, y_pref='ethic_score')
    results['entropy'] = {'metrics_csv': res_ent['metrics_csv'], 'summary_txt': res_ent['summary_txt']}
else:
    results['entropy'] = {'status': 'missing', 'path': ENTROPY_CSV}

# Combined text summary
summ_path = os.path.join(OUT_ROOT, 'alignment_summary.txt')
with open(summ_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    f.write("Cascade Test A — Alignment Summary\n")
    f.write(f"ven_metrics: {results.get('ven',{})}\n")
    f.write(f"entropy_metrics: {results.get('entropy',{})}\n")

print(json.dumps({'status': 'done', 'out_root': OUT_ROOT, **results}))
